newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MINORCO IN PNG DEAL WITH TRIARX .
newsitem.headline: MINORCO IN PNG DEAL WITH TRIARX .

text.p: Minorco, the offshore arm of Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd , said it signed an agreement with Triarx Gold Corp in respect of Triarx's Tingi Valley and Poru exploration properties in Papua New Guinea, believed to be prospective for copper and gold.
The agreement entitles Minorco to earn a 51 percent equity interest in Triarx's PNG properties by expending $11 million on exploration within a period of four years.
Thereafter, Minorco may increase its interest to 80 percent by completing a feasibility study in respect of development of a particular project.
Minorco will be the operator of the joint venture.
The deal remains subject to concluding definitive documentation and to obtaining necessary consents in PNG.
